label: Rich text
description: Formatted text — paragraphs, bold, italics, lists, links, inline code, and quotes — stored as sanitized HTML. Use for ticket descriptions and knowledge-style content where structure helps the reader. The server sanitizes every write to an allow-list of tags, so stored values are always safe to render.
usage: Use for the main description of a record, where people paste structured content.
Use long_text instead for notes that never need formatting; it is easier to search and export.
Keep the default maxLength unless content is known to be short.
constraints: Allowed tags: p, br, strong, em, u, s, code, pre, blockquote, ul, ol, li, h3, h4, a. Links allow only http, https, and mailto and get rel="noopener noreferrer".
Scripts, styles, iframes, objects, embeds, forms, inline style attributes, and on* event handlers are removed (not escaped).
Sanitization runs on the server on every write path (UI, API, imports, automations, AI); the client editor is never trusted.
maxLength counts characters of the sanitized HTML and must be between 1 and 50000 (default 20000).

binding.description: Rendered by a field placement node bound to a field of this type.

accessibility.keyboard: Ctrl/Cmd+B bold, Ctrl/Cmd+I italic, Ctrl/Cmd+K link, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+7/8 numbered/bulleted list. Alt+F10 moves to the toolbar; Esc returns to the text.
accessibility.notes: aria-multiline=true; the formatting toolbar is a role=toolbar with arrow-key navigation and pressed states.

responsive: Full width; the toolbar collapses to a single overflow button below 720px.
